cases.disposition_reason: compare levels reached no color at 120 by 40, kept that band at 80 by 24, then returned to the truecolor band
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: Colour bands for the supported levels are visible, and the page state is unchanged after return.
cases.forbidden_effects: Leaving Compare levels changes the selected page or an option value.

cases.disposition_reason: a held seam drag moves the split and keeps the orders facts before release
cases.action_sequence: Record the thin seam, drag it while the pointer stays down, release, then select order_items.
cases.expected_results: The held shot shows the heavy seam at a new column with the orders facts still in the detail. After release, order_items shows 48,221 rows.
cases.forbidden_effects: The pointer is released before the held shot, or the detail changes row while the seam is held.
